500-813-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-813-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Scholar of the Ages and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Scholar of the Ages tokens enter, they each trigger, returning Cabal Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3510-3875-5929-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
3510-3875-5929-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

339-677-1251-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

222-527-7060-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-7060-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

619-2645-2872-3430.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
619-2645-2872-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1409-3099-5223-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

801-4871-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: One of Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
801-4871-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2082-3490-5330-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2082-3490-5330-7426.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat

3197-4506-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4506-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2961-3175.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5705-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5705-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3899-4785.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4068-5475-5921-5970.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4365-5448-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4365-5448-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2440-3399-3641-4399.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Distinguished Conjurer triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

3490-5070-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5070-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3581-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2131-2541-3885.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return Stinkweed Imp from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing you to discard Stinkweed Imp.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1445-2267-2438-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-2438-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1844-2292-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
1844-2292-5434-5555.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

397-4506-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-4506-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

465-1849-3742-4251-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-1849-3742-4251-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

372-4598-4863.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Revolutionist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
372-4598-4863.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1479-3861-3908.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

654-1682-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-1682-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-1682-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

4605-4681-4753.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Clever Impersonator to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Choose not to have Clever Impersonator copy anything as it enters the battlefield.
Clever Impersonator dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Preston triggers, creating a copy of Clever Impersonator that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Choose to have the Clever Impersonator token enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When the Clever Impersonator token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Clever Impersonator to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Invasion of Tolvada // The Broken Sky

2034-2650-2781.description:
Cast Invasion of Tolvada by paying {3}{W}{B}.
When Invasion of Tolvada enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Invasion of Tolvada.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Invasion of Tolvada.
Repeat from step 2.

2781-3582-4871-4924-5256.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's loyalty abilities have not been used this turn.
2781-3582-4871-4924-5256.description:
Activate Kaya's +1 loyalty ability to put a Ghostform Counter on Felidar Guardian.
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Altar of Dementia to mill target player 0.
Felidar Guardian is returned to your hand, and you create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {W}.
The Spirit dies to having 0 toughness.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {1}.
Cast Felidar Guardian for {1}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, exile Kaya and return her to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1992-2034-2744.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2034-2744.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, adding {C}{C}.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
